test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL - English (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The policeman asked / many people but / no one was knowing / how the accident happened.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'no one was knowing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'no one had known' **should be used instead of** 'no one was knowing'.**
 
• The given sentence is in the **indirect speech.**
 
• If we change the sentence in the **direct speech **here '**knew**' should be used. So, the use of '**was knowing**' is incorrect.
 
• And '**V₂**' is changed into '**had + V₃**' in the '**direct-indirect**' conversion.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The policeman asked many people but **no one had known **how the accident happened.*
